releaseMeaning: This harness reads local evidence and grades the Discord knowledge-base pipeline. It does not approve records, post to Discord, mutate Supabase, sync RAG, call AI models, push, deploy, or satisfy live operating proof.

gates.recovery: Run npm run discord:career-content-harness and fix corpus path/readiness failures.
Run npm run discord:sage-kernel-content-harness and fix source clone/readiness failures.
Add or repair source harnesses until at least 80 candidates and 18 approval-gated drafts are available.

gates.evidence: channels covered: build-lab, content-queue, daily-signal, office-hours, project-submissions, questions, resources
gates.recovery: Balance source candidates across daily-signal, build-lab, resources, questions, office-hours, and content-queue.

gates.evidence: 18 drafts checked for publishAllowedBeforeApproval=false and operatingProofEligible=false
gates.recovery: Ensure every generated draft is pending admin review and cannot claim operating proof before approval.
Run npm run discord:approved-knowledge-packet and fix missing packet fields/checklists.
Run npm run discord:proof-candidate-audit and fix missing critical proof fields.

gates.evidence: source seed and approved-knowledge packet both contain anti-fake proof boundaries
gates.recovery: Add explicit anti-fake rules blocking generated seeds, dry-runs, smoke rows, and raw messages from counting as proof.
Run npm run discord:knowledge-base-e2e-readiness and fix guarded runner/spec cleanup contract failures.
Run npm run rag:discord-corpus-readiness and fix corpus/readiness contract failures.
Run npm run rag:evaluate:coverage-readiness and repair missing eval coverage before RAG claims.
Approve at least 10 reusable, privacy-safe knowledge items before syncing Discord-derived RAG.
With explicit approval, sync approved Discord knowledge into authoritative RAG and rerun evals.
Run npm run verify:local:evidence and fix release evidence failures.
Run npm run loop:audit and fix stale or missing autonomous loop state.
Create and approve four privacy-safe public proof assets from approved Discord knowledge.
Run one premium review, deeper answer, or office-hours flow with authorization and fulfillment evidence.

productionStopConditions: approved_knowledge_target_met: Approve at least 10 reusable, privacy-safe knowledge items before syncing Discord-derived RAG.
rag_sources_target_met: With explicit approval, sync approved Discord knowledge into authoritative RAG and rerun evals.
public_proof_target_met: Create and approve four privacy-safe public proof assets from approved Discord knowledge.
premium_workflow_target_met: Run one premium review, deeper answer, or office-hours flow with authorization and fulfillment evidence.
liveOperatorActions: Approve 10 high-signal Discord knowledge items through the admin review workflow.
Sync approved Discord knowledge into authoritative RAG only after explicit approval.
Approve or publish four privacy-safe public proof assets from approved knowledge.
Complete one premium workflow proof with authorization, SLA, and fulfillment evidence.
Run the guarded knowledge-base E2E command only against an approved Supabase environment.
antiFakeRules: Source seeds and generated drafts are curriculum fuel only; they are not approved Discord knowledge.
Raw Discord messages, dry-run rows, smoke rows, and generated templates cannot satisfy operating proof.
RAG can cite only approved, privacy-safe, source-linked knowledge records.
The system cannot claim 95-99 until live approval, RAG sync, public proof, premium proof, and final scorecard evidence pass.
E2E readiness is not the same as live E2E execution; the guarded Playwright command must pass before claiming admin workflow proof.
